description: SOLITUDE GLOBAL SURPLUS: Port city flooded with imports. Luxury goods and wine are common.
SOLITUDE GLOBAL DEFICIT: The city produces nothing. High demand for raw materials (Ores/Hides) which must be imported.
EAST EMPIRE SATURATION: The market is flooded with fine clothes and spiced wine. Buying is cheap, selling is a loss.
LEGION SUPPLY: The Legion is preparing for war. They pay a premium for iron, steel, and weapons.
NOBLE MATERIALS: Jewelers have plenty of rings but starve for raw Gold, Silver, and Gems to craft custom pieces.
FUR FASHION: Rugged northern furs are the trend at court, but nobles refuse to hunt. High markup on pristine pelts.
MAGIC BAN: Stigma against necromancy (Potema). Dark magic items are considered contraband and yield trash prices.
